info.title: TradeSieve API
info.summary: Canonical contract for evidence-oriented trade-compliance screening and human review
info.description: Draft Phase 1 contract. A successful API response is not legal clearance. Only an authorized human decision can create HUMAN_CLEARED for a named action, scope, and expiry.

get.summary: Check service and required coverage readiness

200.description: Runtime and required configured coverage are ready

post.description: Creates a reproducible screening result and, when findings/workflow exist, a case. HTTP success does not mean clearance.

201.description: Screening result created; inspect business_action and state

200.description: Idempotent replay of the original committed result

get.summary: Get the current authorized case projection

202.description: Evidence accepted for validation/review; current action remains authoritative

post.summary: Record a scoped authorized human decision
post.description: Requires a named human identity with the applicable final-decision role and configured state/completeness/four-eyes checks. Service and agent identities are denied.

get.summary: List authorized source status and freshness

resolved_finding_ids.description: Findings resolved by this disposition. It may be empty for HUMAN_BLOCKED or CLOSED_NO_ACTION; application policy requires HUMAN_CLEARED to resolve every open P0/P1 finding.
